title: Purchasing Supervisor
description: Official Radisson Hotel Group purchasing role at Nofa Resort Riyadh focused on day-to-day hotel purchasing support and financial process control. The role covers sourcing quality products, handling enquiries and problem resolution, delivering purchasing tasks on time, supporting departmental targets, and collaborating with the manager on cost and inventory control. Hotel purchasing experience is beneficial but not essential, making it a cleaner support-side operations and procurement opening than the more senior specialist roles.
